description:
Returns the [default actors](#api-rest-api-3-resolution-get) for the project role.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the project role. Use [Get all project roles](#api-rest-api-3-role-get) to get a list of project role IDs.
parameters.name: id

200.description: Returned if the request is successful.

400.description: Returned if the request is invalid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

403.description: Returned if the user does not have administrative permissions.

404.description: Returned if the project role is not found.

summary: Get default actors for project role
